children: Mohajer Keyvan, a 10% owner and CEO, reported a sale of Class A Common Stock on September 15, 2026. The shares sold totaled 137,290 at $6.3286 per share. The total sale amount reported was $868,853. Following the transaction, Mohajer Keyvan directly owned 3,684,947 Class A Common Stock. The filing notes the sale was made to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of restricted stock units granted on August 3, 2023; August 1, 2024; July 31, 2025; and July 30, 2026.
